definitions.explanation: The Japanese government ministry responsible for environmental policy: pollution control, climate change, waste and recycling, and national parks. It was created in 2001 by upgrading the former Environment Agency ({環境庁|かんきょうちょう}, founded 1971).

examples.japanese: {環境省|かんきょうしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The Ministry of the Environment announced the results of its survey.

examples.japanese: {環境省|かんきょうしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}→熱中症：08330_necchuushou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}びかけている→呼びかける：06480_yobikakeru⟧。
examples.english: The Ministry of the Environment is urging people to watch out for heatstroke.

examples.japanese: {環境省|かんきょうしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{地球温暖化|ちきゅうおんだんか}→地球温暖化：18873_chikyuuondanka⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦クールビズ→クールビズ：29551_kuurubizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: The Ministry of the Environment started Cool Biz as one of its measures against global warming.

notes:
One of the ministries (⟦{省庁|しょうちょう}→省庁：13703_shouchou⟧) of the national government; its head is the Minister of the Environment ({環境大臣|かんきょうだいじん}). It appears in the news mostly on climate, pollution, wildlife, and summer heat.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {環境省|かんきょうしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧: an announcement by the Ministry of the Environment
- {環境大臣|かんきょうだいじん}: the Minister of the Environment
- ⟦クールビズ→クールビズ：29551_kuurubizu⟧: the light summer office dress campaign the ministry launched in 2005
- ⟦{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}→熱中症：08330_necchuushou⟧⟦{警戒|けいかい}→警戒：14224_keikai⟧⟦アラート→アラート：10737_araato⟧: the heatstroke alert it issues together with the Japan Meteorological Agency
- ⟦{国立公園|こくりつこうえん}→国立公園：17724_kokuritsukouen⟧: the national parks it manages
